name: io.github.tonyyang0504/yahoo_shopping_jp-mcp
description: Yahoo! Shopping (JP) (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listing. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Yahoo! JAPAN Client ID (アプリケーションID) of an app approved for the Shopping store APIs, linked to the store's Business ID.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's シークレット (sent as HTTP Basic to the YConnect v2 token endpoint).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: YConnect v2 refresh token from one authorization-code consent by the store's Yahoo! JAPAN ID (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/help/#accesstoken). It lasts 4 weeks; re-consent afterwards.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: ストアアカウント (store account id, lower-case letters, digits, - and _).
